Name: Magic Stardew (Beta)
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[center][b]﻿Magic Stardew[/b] brings a fresh layer of magic to your farm life!
Unlock powerful spells, grow your magical skills, and manage your mana carefully to maximize your potential.[/center]
[b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Mana System[/b] – A dedicated mana bar with regeneration and max mana growth.[/*]
[*][b]Spell Book [/b]- Contains multiple pages of spells. You can switch between pages using your mouse [b]scroll wheel[/b] or with [b]LB / RB[/b] on a controller.[/*]
[*][b]Spell Learning[/b] – Unlock spells through gameplay events and exploration.[/*]
[*][b]Ring slot[/b] - You can insert the book into the ring slot to open it using the assigned button "C" instead of searching for it in your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Leveling System[/b] – Level up your spells through repeated use to lower their mana cost and boost your max mana. To view current levels, use spell_list command.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer Support[/b] – Fully synchronized mana and spell progression for all players.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Spell Info Tooltip[/b] – Whenever you unlock a new spell, a [b]question mark[/b] appears on it. Hover over it with your mouse (or hold [b]Right Trigger[/b] on controller) to see detailed information about the spell, including effects of leveling it up and how its mana cost improves.[/*]
[*][b]Favorite Spells System[/b] – Mark up to 5 spells as favorites to always have them shown at the top of your spellbook. To do this, right-click on a spell and assign it to one of the 5 favorite slots. To remove it, right-click again on the assigned spell and choose remove. On controller, use Left Trigger.[/*]
[*][b]Quick Cast System[/b] - Once a spell is added to your favorites, you can [b]cast it instantly[/b] without opening the spellbook. Hold [b]Shift + 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5[/b] to immediately cast the corresponding favorite spell. This allows for [b]fast combat casting and utility spell use[/b] without interrupting gameplay. Quick casting respects mana cost and cooldowns exactly like normal casting.[/*]
[/list]Whether you’re speeding up your farm work, teleporting around Pelican Town, or experimenting with magical buffs, Magic Stardew turns you into the wizard your grandpa always knew you could be.



[size=4][b]How to Get the Spellbook[/b]
To obtain the Spellbook, you must first meet [b]Ashara[/b]. After spending some time in the valley, she will eventually visit you. Once you have unlocked the [b]bundles [/b]in the [b]Community Center[/b] and met [b]Ashara[/b], she will give you a quest that rewards you with the Spellbook, granting you access to the world of magic.
Alternatively, you can obtain it instantly by using the console command: spellbook_give[/size]
